# ModuKit

> Modular plugin host framework & polyglot extension toolkit: Rust kernel,
> C ABI as the only cross-language exit, generated bindings for C++/Python/JS.

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — project facts, conventions, commands, gates
- [architecture](docs/architecture.md) — adjudicated baseline (section 11 = decision index)
- [whitepaper](docs/whitepaper.md) — positioning and v1.0 canon
- [modules](docs/modules/00-overview.md) — reading order for the 00-11 deep dives
- [capability ledger](docs/capability-ledger.md) — embed/plugin verb map
- [VE-parity plan](docs/ve-parity-plan.md) — non-functional port, B0-B8
- [reference roster](docs/reference/README.md) — external project profiles
- [environment guide](docs/env.md) — pixi, tasks, MCP lifecycle
- [book](book/toc.toml) — mdBook chapter order (B6)
- [SDD contracts](docs/sdd/) — clause/test trace (B6)

## Crates
- modukit-core — lifecycle state machine, registry, in-process bus, clock, observability
- modukit-runtime — modukit-run / modukit-host / modukit-debug-reader binaries
- modukit-transport — narrow transport seam, socketpair/memfd, SCM_RIGHTS fdpass, vendor-shm
- modukit-codegen — protoc plugin, Rust/C ABI/C++/Py/JS faces, wire goldens
- modukit-js — napi bridge over the C ABI

## Contracts
- [embed ABI](contracts/modukit_embed.h) — the C embedding surface
- [plugin ABI](contracts/modukit_plugin.h) — modukit_plugin_init and HostAbi tables
- [process wire](contracts/modukit_wire.h) — TL frame prefix + payload grammar
- [kernel proto](contracts/modukit.proto) — proto2 ledger
- [wire goldens](contracts/golden/wire-v1) — regression frames
